posts.title: sveltejs/svelte
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Svelte는 선언적 컴포넌트를 효율적인 JavaScript 코드로 컴파일하여 DOM을 정밀하게 업데이트하는 웹 애플리케이션 빌드 도구입니다. 이는 전통적인 프레임워크와 달리 런타임에서가 아니라 빌드 단계에서 코드가 최적화되어 실행 성능을 높이는 접근법을 제공합니다. 공식 웹사이트와 Discord 채팅방에서 추가 정보를 얻을 수 있습니다. 오픈 소스 프로젝트로서 활발히 개발 중이며 자원봉사자들의 참여로 유지되고 있습니다.

## 주요 기능

- 컴파일 기반 프레임워크로 런타임 오버헤드 최소화
- 선언적 컴포넌트 작성 및 DOM을 효율적으로 갱신
- JavaScript로 변환되어 빠른 실행 가능
- MIT 라이선스를 적용하여 자유로운 이용 가능

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- 웹 애플리케이션 개발 시 빠른 동작과 작은 번들 크기가 필요한 프로젝트
- 프레임워크 런타임 부하를 줄이고자 하는 UI 컴포넌트 개발
- 학습이 쉬운 모던 웹 개발 방법론 체험
- 오픈 소스 생태계에서 활발한 커뮤니티 지원 활용

## 시작하기

README에는 별도의 설치 및 시작 방법 명시가 없으나, 추가 정보와 문서는 공식 사이트(svelte.dev)에서 확인 가능하다.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- 컴파일러 개념이 익숙하지 않은 개발자에게는 다소 진입 장벽 존재 가능
- 런타임이 아닌 빌드 타임 변환 방식을 이해해야 함
- `.dev` 도메인 웹사이트 접속 문제 가능성에 대한 안내가 포함됨

## 선정 기준과 저장소 정보

- 저장소 보관 상태: 보관되지 않음
- 수집 시각: 2026-11-17 16:31 KST

posts.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

last30days-skill is an AI agent-based search tool that aggregates recent content from multiple platforms including Reddit, X (Twitter), YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and others to provide a synthesized, engagement-ranked summary about a topic. It leverages real engagement signals like upvotes, likes, and market odds rather than editor-curated content, offering fresh insights often missing from traditional search engines. The tool supports numerous data sources for research on people, companies, trends, and events within the last 30 days. This approach enables users to prepare for meetings, monitor emerging topics, or stay informed about ongoing developments effectively.

## 주요 기능

- Aggregates and synthesizes data across diverse platforms (social media, news, research, market data).
- Ranks information based on real user engagement such as upvotes, likes, and betting odds.
- Supports discovery mode to surface trending topics with velocity rankings and cross-source analysis.
- Provides specialized 'secret signals' like patent filings and job postings to detect upcoming company actions.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Prepare for meetings by gathering recent relevant information on individuals or companies.
- Monitor real-time trends and topics exploding in popularity across communities.
- Research companies' unannounced projects via patent and hiring insights.
- Get comprehensive, multi-source summaries about persons, products, or news stories not covered by conventional search engines.

## 시작하기

Installation options include using Claude Code's plugin marketplace, Grok CLI, npx agent skills for over 50 hosts, or manual installation via cloning the GitHub repo and symlinking. After installation, run the `/last30days` command with your topic query. Some data sources require API keys or tokens, which you can provide for fuller access. The README provides detailed installation and setup instructions for different platforms.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Full functionality requires API keys or tokens for some platforms (e.g., X/Twitter, YouTube).
- Some integrations depend on additional CLI tools or browser sessions for authentication.
- Windows support for Claude Desktop is deferred as of now.
- Multiple installation methods coexist but may lead to duplicate entries if combined on one machine.

posts.title: obra/superpowers
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Superpowers is a comprehensive software development methodology and framework designed for AI coding agents. It structures development through stages including brainstorming, design approval, detailed planning, subagent-driven task execution, test-driven development, and rigorous code review. The system emphasizes simplicity, evidence-based verification, and systematic workflows rather than ad-hoc coding. It supports various AI coding platforms through plugins and offers commercial support options.

## 주요 기능

- Agentic skills framework enabling autonomous coding agents.
- Subagent-driven development with task decomposition and review.
- Integration of test-driven development (TDD) with enforced RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycles.
- Comprehensive collaboration skills including brainstorming, planning, code review, and branch management.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Accelerating software development by autonomous AI agents following clear plans.
- Ensuring high-quality code via systematic testing and reviews.
- Managing complex coding projects with modular subagent task delegation.
- Supporting multiple AI coding platforms through a unified methodology.

## 시작하기

Installation varies by platform; users install the Superpowers plugin via their respective AI coding agent’s marketplace or plugin system. The README provides detailed install commands for many environments including Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Gemeni CLI, and others.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Skill updates must be compatible across all supported coding agents.
- Contributions of new skills are generally not accepted to maintain system integrity.
- Long AI sessions may lose bootstrap effects due to session compaction on some platforms (e.g., Hermes Agent).
- Visual companion telemetry is enabled by default but can be opt-out via environment variables to protect usage privacy.

posts.title: affaan-m/ECC - Agent Harness Performance Optimization System
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

ECC is an open-source engineering system designed to optimize AI agents' development workflows. It provides coordinated planning, testing, implementation, review, verification, memory, and improvement processes tailored for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex. ECC includes over 70 specialized agents, 300 skills, commands, hooks, rules, and security scanning tools to enhance productivity and code quality. The system supports multiple harnesses and integrates with various LLM-based coding tools through native plugins or adapters.

## 주요 기능

- Coordinated engineering workflow with planning, testing, review, and continuous improvement.
- Extensive library of 72 agents and 327 skills covering development, security, research, and more.
- Native plugin support for Claude Code, Codex, and adapters for many other coding harnesses.
- AgentShield security scanning and continuous learning with hooks and memory management.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Enhancing AI agent-based code generation with structured development processes.
- Automating code review, testing, and code quality checks within AI coding workflows.
- Integrating AI engineering skills and workflows into multiple LLM-based coding platforms.
- Improving productivity and reducing manual repetition for AI-assisted software projects.

## 시작하기

Use the guided setup with Node.js 18+ by running 'npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup' for Claude Code plugin installation. The process includes prerequisite checks for Git, Claude Code, and Node, then allows choosing install scopes and hook profiles interactively. Detailed setup steps are available for Windows and other environments. Alternate installation methods exist for Codex and other harnesses, with native plugin commands for Claude Code also supported.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Install ECC only from verified official sources to avoid malware risks.
- Do not stack multiple installation methods for the same harness to prevent conflicts or duplication.
- Ensure all prerequisites like Node.js 18+, Git, and Claude Code 2.1+ are installed and accessible in PATH before setup.
- Follow the recommended setup methods and consult support documentation if installation issues occur.
